$comment: The GitHub App permissions of each agent role, in the keys and values of GitHub's App manifest (`default_permissions`). The roles table in 03-agents.md is the rule; this file is its machine-readable twin, read by `kanon apps` to build each App's manifest, and tests/unit/agent-permissions.test.ts fails when the two disagree (K-PRIN-2). Each role holds its row of the roles table plus Metadata: read, which K-ADOPT-8 adds to every App. Change the table and this file in the same commit.
